Judah Lewis is an American actor who gained recognition as a young performer in film and television. Here's what I know about him:

## Early Life
- Born in 2001 (specific date varies by source)
- American actor who began his career as a child performer

## Notable Film Roles
- **"The Babysitter" (2017)** - His breakout role as Cole, the main protagonist in this Netflix horror-comedy film directed by McG
- **"The Babysitter: Killer Queen" (2020)** - Reprised his role as Cole in the sequel
- **"Demolition" (2015)** - Appeared alongside Jake Gyllenhaal and Naomi Watts
- **"Deliverance Creek" (2014)** - Lifetime movie
- **"The Christmas Chronicles" (2018)** - Featured in this Netflix holiday film with Kurt Russell

## Television Work
- **"Game of Silence" (2016)** - Had a recurring role in this NBC series
- **"Point of Honor" (2015)** - Amazon pilot

## Acting Style
He's known for playing relatable teenage characters, often in coming-of-age stories with horror or comedy elements. His performance in "The Babysitter" particularly showcased his ability to balance comedy with more dramatic moments.

His career has primarily focused on genre films, particularly those aimed at younger audiences on streaming platforms. He's part of a generation of young actors who've found success through Netflix original productions.
